item.title: 🔵 UAC-0145 Uses ClickFix CAPTCHAs to Infect Ukrainian Devices wih Malware
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.
Russian state-sponsored threat actors have been observed leveraging the infamous ClickFix strategy to trick Ukrainian targets into infecting their own machines with data-stealing malware. item.title: 🟠 SonicWall SMA Zero-Days Exploited Before Disclosure to Gain Root Access
item.description:
Why this matters: Service impact possible — prepare comms and confirm vendor status.
